#!/bin/sh
# >>> ennyn commit-check: keep this block first in the hook, before any other command.
# Printed by ennyn install-hook. It checks every commit this hook sees, whatever the rest of the hook skips.
(
  id='ennyn-ennyn'
  top=$(pwd -P)
  kept=
  rest=${PATH:-}:
  while [ -n "$rest" ]; do
    dir=${rest%%:*}
    rest=${rest#*:}
    case $dir in
      /*) ;;
      *) continue ;;
    esac
    real=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || continue
    case $real/ in
      "$top"/*) continue ;;
    esac
    kept=${kept:+$kept:}$dir
  done
  PATH=${kept:-/nonexistent}
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ennyn: node not found; commit message not checked." >&2
    exit 0
  fi
  windows=
  case $(uname -s 2>/dev/null) in
    MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) windows=1 ;;
  esac
  if [ -n "${ENNYN_PLUGIN_DATA:-}" ]; then
    data=$ENNYN_PLUGIN_DATA
  elif [ -n "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-}" ]; then
    data=$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plugins/data/$id
  elif [ -n "${HOME:-}" ]; then
    data=$HOME/.claude/plugins/data/$id
  else
    printf '%s\n' "ennyn: HOME is not set, so the plugin's data directory is unknown and this commit is refused." 'Set HOME, or ENNYN_PLUGIN_DATA to the data directory of the plugin; or take this block out of the hook.' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  absolute=
  case $data in
    *[[:cntrl:]]*) ;;
    /*) absolute=1 ;;
    [A-Za-z]:[\\/]*) [ -z "$windows" ] || absolute=1 ;;
  esac
  if [ -z "$absolute" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "ennyn: the plugin's data directory is no absolute path, or holds a control character, so this commit is refused." 'Set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR as Claude Code has it, or ENNYN_PLUGIN_DATA to the data directory; or take this block out of the hook.' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -d "$data" ]; then
    real=$(cd "$data" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)
    if [ -z "$real" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "ennyn: the plugin's data directory $data cannot be read, so this commit is refused." 'Make it readable; or take this block out of the hook.' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    case $real/ in
      "$top"/*)
        printf '%s\n' "ennyn: the plugin's data directory $data lies inside this work tree, where the repository could choose what runs, so this commit is refused." 'Keep the data directory and the version of the plugin outside the repository; or take this block out of the hook.' >&2
        exit 1 ;;
    esac
  fi
  record="$data/root"
  if [ ! -e "$record" ] && [ ! -L "$record" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "ennyn: no plugin version is recorded in $data (the ennyn plugin is not installed for this user, was uninstalled, or has not run since), so the commit message is not checked." 'A Claude Code session with the plugin records it; or take this block out of the hook.' >&2
    exit 0
  fi
  if [ -L "$record" ] || [ ! -f "$record" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "ennyn: $record is no record Ennyn wrote (a link, or not a regular file), so this commit is refused." 'Delete it, then start a Claude Code session with the plugin, which records its version; or take this block out of the hook.' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  line=
  { IFS= read -r line < "$record"; } 2>/dev/null
  root=
  case $line in
    *[[:cntrl:]]*) ;;
    /*) root=$line ;;
    [A-Za-z]:[\\/]*) [ -z "$windows" ] || root=$line ;;
  esac
  cli="$root/scripts/ennyn.mjs"
  if [ -z "$root" ] || [ ! -f "$cli" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "ennyn: the plugin version recorded in $record is no absolute path to a version that is there, so this commit is refused." 'Start a Claude Code session with the plugin, which records the version it runs; if the plugin is uninstalled, take this block out of the hook.' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  real=$(cd "$root/scripts" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)
  case $real/ in
    "$top"/*)
      printf '%s\n' "ennyn: the plugin version recorded in $record lies inside this work tree, where the repository could choose what runs, so this commit is refused." 'Keep the data directory and the version of the plugin outside the repository; or take this block out of the hook.' >&2
      exit 1 ;;
  esac
  exec node "$cli" commit-check --hook "$1"
) || exit $?
# <<< ennyn commit-check
IFS= read -r s < "$1"
case $s in
  Merge*|Revert*) exit 0 ;;
esac
